paragraphs: Mentioned in [Chullin 30b](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.30b.16): Rava inspected an arrow for him, and a bird was slaughtered with it in flight.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The end of Chullin 30b names Rabbi Yonah bar Tachlifa as the person for whom Rava inspects the arrow.

The Hebrew verb for slaughtering leaves its subject implicit. The Davidson English at the end of 30b makes Rava the subject. The [start of 31a](https://www.sefaria.org/Chullin.31a.1) continues with the Gemara’s discussion of how the arrow cut. [Heilprin’s account](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1865&lang=en) likewise leaves the subject unstated in the Hebrew.
